basic_details.job_title: IISER Kolkata Junior Research Fellow (Biological Sciences) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

content_sections.heading: About the Terrestrial Ecology Laboratory
content_sections.text: The Terrestrial Ecology Laboratory is at IISER Kolkata, Mohanpur, District Nadia, West Bengal. The project PI is Dr. Robert John Chandran, Professor, Department of Biological Sciences. The post is on an ongoing project funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Geoinformatics / Geoscience / GIS and Remote Sensing / Life Sciences / Ecology/Environmental Science. B. Tech degree in Engineering with the appropriate GATE qualification. The candidate should be highly motivated to conduct high-quality analyses and possess relevant skills in landscape and spatial data analysis using a combination of R, Python, Google Earth Engine, ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, etc. The candidate should have qualified in at least one National Exam, such as CSIR/UGC NET-LS, GATE, ICAR-NET, JGEEBILS, or an equivalent. At least 2 years' work experience in relevant projects funded by Government Agencies. Experience and inclination towards ecological sciences and some field work experience on ecosystems or ecologically rich landscapes. Age limit and age relaxation will be as per GOI rules. The notice prints no figure or cut-off date for age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is based on ANRF norms, including HRA, i.e., Rs. 37,000 + 8,880. The employment will be for a period of ONE YEAR, which may be extended beyond one year based on performance and motivation of the candidate. The notice also says that highly skilled and motivated candidates who can multitask in fieldwork may look forward to a two-year appointment, the latter as a Senior Research Fellow.

content_sections.heading: IISER Kolkata Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct landscape ecological analyses of land-cover changes, species diversity, and above- and below-ground carbon assessments in forest and grassland ecosystems in the Terai ecoregion. Work with primary and secondary datasets at regional scales, in collaboration with a team of field biologists. Be based at IISER Kolkata, with occasional fieldwork in and around multiple Terai protected areas, including Manas, Jaldapara, Valmiki, and Rajaji.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Kolkata Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Send the CV by email to [email protected] . Give full personal and professional details in the CV. Include the names of at least two referees. Add a statement of suitability for the position, clearly indicating past research experience in various projects. Include scanned mark sheets, national exam qualification certificates, and proof of work experience, all uploaded as a single PDF file. Write the subject line "Landscape Ecology JRF". Make sure the email is received by 28 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only highly suitable candidates will be shortlisted for the interviews. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview. The notice gives no interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The project is ongoing, and the selected candidates are expected to join immediately after selection. The extension beyond one year depends on performance and motivation of the candidate.
